snippet.title: 40-Questions with Maulana ISHAQ Madani رحمہ اللہ (By Engineer Muhammad Ali Mirza on 23-March-2012)
snippet.description:
🔥 NOTE : If you see any Video Ad. in start of this video, that is only due to the New Policy of YouTube applied in Nov-2023 ! ! ! ❤ Contact Us at +92-321-5900162 (09:00 am to 05:00 pm)
😭 My Life Story ! ! ! 🔥 My Journey in Search of TRUTH ! 🔥 Firqas to Real ISLAM ! ❤ Engineer Muhammad Ali Mirza : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=at1s-OqWb_A
#QuranClass #Tafseer #engineermuhammadalimirza 
00:00 - Start & Introduction !!
0:00:11 | Ghadeer r khum ki hadees - Hazrat Ali AS ko Wasee
0:05:10 | Quran Majeed Hazrat Abu Bakr RA aur Hazrat Usman RA kay daur mein jama kiya gaya - Why
0:07:05 | Saat qiratein
0:07:56 | Rajam Ki Saza - Hazrat Umar RA ka khutba - Boorha aur Boorhay ko rajam karo
0:09:28 | Hazrat Ayesha AS aur Razaat ki ayaat - quran ki ayat - sahih muslim
0:10:54 | Sahih Bukhari - Hazrat Ali AS ko quran kay ilawa kya sikhaya
0:11:52 | Ahl e biddat ki suhbat mein baithna haraam hai - kaun see books parhein - shia ya sunni
0:13:25 | Rajam ki ahadees
0:16:06 | Hazrat Maaviya per mauqaf
0:18:46 | Ahl-e-sunnat nay Hazrat Maaviya Say Ahadees kiyu lee hain
0:19:58 | Imam Ibn Taimiyya RA - Naasbiyat ki boo aati hai
0:20:57 | Meray Sahaba ko Bura Mat Kaho - Yeh kya Hazrat Maaviya Kay liyey bhi hai
0:22:10 | Ghazwa Khandak - Hazrat Maaviya nay yeh kiyu kaha kay main Hazrat Umar RA say ziada Haqdaar hoo - Falan kaun hain - Hazrat Abu Musa Ashari RA - Tareekh
0:24:11 | Hazrat Saad bin ubada RA nay bayt nahi kee - un ka kya ho ga
0:25:17 | Hazrat Ali AS nay 6 month kay baad bayt kee - kya khilafat mein ijma nahi ho gaya
0:27:39 | Hazrat Hassan AS ko Zahr Kis Nay diya hai
0:29:17 | Hazrat Maaviya nay yazid ko muqarar kiya - Hazrat Ali AS nay Hazrat Hassan AS ko khalifa muqarar kiya tha
0:30:03 | Bukhari muslim main - 12 khalifa
0:32:10 | Sahih Bukhari - Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir RA jannat ki taraf bulaey ga aur doosra garoh dozakh ki taraf bulaey ga
0:33:55 | Abu Ghadiya dozakhi hai - to woh to raavi hain ahadees kay aur bait e rizwan kay hain
0:34:45 | Kya tamaam sahab direct janat mein jaaein gay
0:36:22 | Waqia Harra ki waja - Hazrat Abdullah Ibn Umar RA nay Bayt kiyu nahi Hazrat Ali AS
0:38:03 | Hazrat Hussain AS nay kharooj kiyu karein
0:42:42 | Hum kiyu khilafat qaim karein - unho nay kiyun nahi kiya aisa
0:44:14 | medina chornay waali hadees
0:44:57 | Hazrat Ali AS nay medina kiyu chor diya
0:46:22 | Abdullah ibn Zubair RA - shia ko kiyu chir hai
0:47:40 | Mukhtar Saqfi - jhoota hai ya nahi - Nabi honay ka dawa
0:50:05 | Abdullah ibn Saba
0:51:57 | Aap Hazrat Ammar RA ko bara munafiq hain
0:52:44 | Khilafat e Rashida kay baad jihad
0:53:42 | abu ayoob ansaari aur maaviya kay darmiyaan waqia
0:55:12 | hauz e kausar ashaabi - sahabi ki tareef
0:56:59 | Hazrat Talha aur Hazrat Zubair nay kya bayt ker lee thee
0:57:40 | Hazrat Maaviya nay Hazrat Ayesha AS ko shaheed kiya
0:58:10 | Abdullah ibn abbass RA ka kya bana - muta
0:59:53 | Hazrat Ibn Abbass ka khwaab - Kya RasoolALLAH S.A.W. karbala mein maujood thay
1:00:42 | Maghrib ki namaz parhnay kay baad aftaar kertay thay- mauta ki riwayat
1:04:28 | Itihaad e ummat kay liyey quran - aqeeda tauheed main masla hai - un kay saath hum kaisay itihaad ker lain
1:10:56 | namaz kay andar firohi masail - surah faatiha
